title: Use Container Selection screen without causing issues (avoid unnecessary clicking) and interpret tote presence colors
summary: Use the OptiSweep HMI screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes” to safely identify whether a rack/tile has a tote (dark blue) or is empty (light blue), select a container/tile to reveal a box icon and tote number, and locate a tote by entering a location number in the “Location” field and selecting the associated rack/AGV when it is present in the system. The source warns that unnecessary clicking during this screen review can cause more problems—so minimize interactions and only click when needed.
when_to_use: When you need to identify tote presence/absence on the “Container Selection 1 Totes” HMI screen and/or locate a tote by location number, while avoiding unnecessary clicking that can cause issues.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Container Selection screen interactions needed to identify tote presence (dark blue vs light blue), select the correct container/tile to view the box icon and tote number, and perform location-based lookup using the “Location” field.
safety_notes: Avoid unnecessary clicking while reviewing the Container Selection screen; the source states that trying to click something during the slide can cause more problems.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the “Container Selection 1 Totes” HMI screen
HMI controls for selecting a container/tile and the “Location” input field

access_required: Access to the “Container Selection 1 Totes” HMI screen
system_preconditions: The tote/rack/AGV you are trying to identify must be present in the system for the location lookup to return the associated rack/AGV.

steps.title: Open the “Container Selection 1 Totes” screen
steps.purpose: Get to the correct HMI screen where tote presence colors, selection behavior, and location lookup are available.
steps.instruction: Navigate to and display the HMI screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes”.
steps.expected_result: The “Container Selection 1 Totes” screen is visible, including the rack/tile area and the “Location” field.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the rack/tile tiles and the “Location” field on the Container Selection screen.
steps.failure_condition: The “Container Selection 1 Totes” screen is not displayed, or the “Location” field is not visible.

actions.label: Open Container Selection 1 Totes
actions.exact_action: Open/locate the HMI screen shown in the source frame: “Container Selection 1 Totes” (Container Selection).

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text includes “Container Selection 1 Totes” and “Location”.

steps.title: Avoid unnecessary clicking while reviewing the screen
steps.purpose: Prevent unintended interactions that the source warns can cause more problems.
steps.instruction: Before interacting with tiles/controls, follow the source guidance to avoid unnecessary clicking (only click when you need to select a specific container/tile or perform the location lookup).
steps.expected_result: You have minimized clicks and only perform the next required interaction (color identification, selection, or location lookup).
steps.healthy_condition: No unintended tile/container selections occur while you are just reviewing the slide/screen.
steps.failure_condition: You click around unnecessarily and observe unexpected behavior or unintended selections.

actions.label: Point out where not to click
actions.exact_action: Before interacting, follow the source guidance to avoid unnecessary clicking while reviewing the slide (“point out where not to click”).

stop_or_escalate_if: If unexpected behavior occurs after clicking, stop interacting and request assistance.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “point out where not to click… It will cause more problems… like like trying to click something.”
Transcript warning: “the worst you can do is… if you’re looking at an active system, if you click on AG when you remove it, that’s… pretty bad.”

steps.title: Interpret tote presence using dark blue vs light blue tiles
steps.purpose: Determine whether a rack/tile has a tote present or is empty.
steps.instruction: Look at the color state of the rack/tile: dark blue indicates tote presence; light blue indicates an empty rack.
steps.expected_result: You can correctly classify each tile as tote-present (dark blue) or empty rack (light blue).
steps.healthy_condition: Dark blue tiles correspond to racks with a tote; light blue tiles correspond to racks without a tote.
steps.failure_condition: A tile’s color state does not match the tote presence you observe after selection (box icon/tote number), or you cannot reliably distinguish dark blue vs light blue.

actions.label: Check tile color state
actions.exact_action: Identify the rack/tile color state: confirm whether the tile is dark blue (tote present) or light blue (empty rack).

stop_or_escalate_if: If color interpretation appears inconsistent with selection results, stop and request assistance rather than continuing to click around.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text: “Dark blue indicates the presence of a tote. While light blue represents empty rack.”
Transcript: “dark blue… means it has a tote… light blue… means it’s empty.”

steps.title: Select a container/tile and verify box icon + tote number
steps.purpose: Confirm tote identity for a selected rack/tile.
steps.instruction: If you need to select an item, select the intended container/tile and observe that a box icon appears along with the tote number.
steps.expected_result: After selecting the correct tile, a box icon is shown and the tote number is displayed for that selected container/tile.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected tile shows the box icon and the tote number (matching the tote presence indicated by the tile color).
steps.failure_condition: Selecting a tile does not show the box icon and tote number as described.

actions.label: Select the intended container/tile
actions.exact_action: If you need to select an item, select the intended container/tile and observe that a box icon appears along with the tote number.

stop_or_escalate_if: If selecting items does not show the box icon and tote number as described, stop and escalate for support rather than continuing to click around.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text: “If you select it, a box icon will show… as well as the tote number.”
Nearby text: “Dark blue indicates… tote… If you select it, a box icon will show… as well as the tote number.”

steps.title: Find a tote by entering a location number and selecting the associated rack/AGV
steps.purpose: Locate where a tote is in the system using the “Location” field.
steps.instruction: Type the location number into the “Location” field, then select the rack or AGV where it is located (only if it is in the system).
steps.expected_result: After entering the location number and selecting the associated rack/AGV, the screen reflects the tote’s location context (i.e., you can identify the correct rack/tile associated with that location).
steps.healthy_condition: The rack/AGV associated with the entered location number is selectable and corresponds to the tote’s presence state (dark blue vs light blue).
steps.failure_condition: The rack/AGV associated with the entered location number does not appear/select as expected, or the resulting selected tile does not show the expected tote identity.

actions.label: Enter location number
actions.exact_action: To find a tote by location, type the location number into the “Location” field

actions.label: Select associated rack/AGV
actions.exact_action: …and then select the rack or AGV where it is located (when it is in the system).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot locate the tote by the entered location number (despite it being present), stop and request assistance rather than continuing to click around.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text: “You can also find a tote by typing the Location [number] in and selecting the rack or AGV it’s located on if it’s in the system.”
Transcript: “You can also find a tote by typing the tote number on this container section… it will take you to the part of the map where that tote is…”

success_criteria: Dark blue tiles are correctly identified as tote-present; light blue tiles are correctly identified as empty racks.
Selecting the intended container/tile results in a box icon and the tote number being displayed.
Entering a location number in the “Location” field and selecting the associated rack/AGV (when present) allows you to identify the tote’s location context.
healthy_conditions: Tile colors (dark blue vs light blue) match tote presence/absence.
Selection produces the box icon and tote number for the selected tile.
Location lookup returns an associated rack/AGV when the tote is in the system.
failure_conditions: Selecting items does not show the box icon and tote number as described.
Unnecessary clicking causes unexpected behavior; you observe unintended selections or inconsistent UI state.
escalation_guidance: If selection does not show the box icon and tote number as described, stop and escalate for support rather than continuing to click around.
If the source warning about clicking causing more problems is observed (unexpected behavior), stop interacting and request assistance.
